concern_results.conclusion: The shown handler addresses partial-walk descriptor leaks. The omitted remainder of the reader prevents verifying its complete resource-ownership contract.
Quoted contract bytes reach the secret-scanner call. Reader containment remains unverifiable, and the previously identified receipt-relocation concern remains unresolved.
The handler preserves GateError, retains OSError wrapping, and attempts subsequent descriptor closes even when an individual close fails.
The regression checks descriptor-count stability across repeated missing-file and linked-ancestor failures. It does not cover the reader's remaining lifecycle.
The delta changes no public signature, CLI contract, or React/browser behavior. The regression requires a POSIX host exposing /dev/fd.
The code supports the targeted cleanup mechanism; numerical execution results and feature-wide verification remain author claims. The ledger rewrite conflates earlier and later evidence.
Neither quoted contract is changed or loosened, and no conflicting rule is demonstrated. Required validation runs are claimed but not independently evidenced in the packet.
